headline: Graphic Designer
tagline: Graphic designer with extensive experience producing high-quality digital and print creatives, brand identity extensions, and multi-format marketing collateral.

skills.label: Design Tools
skills.items: Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop, CorelDRAW, Framer, Webflow

skills.label: Core Competencies
skills.items: Branding and visual identity, typography, layout, print production, social and marketing creative, design systems

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives across employee engagement, branding, recruitment, onboarding, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Designed banners, standees, certificates, ID cards, presentations, and marketing collateral.
Collaborated with HR and management stakeholders, maintaining low revision cycles.
Managed print-ready files focusing on bleed, sizing, colour accuracy, typography, colour systems, layout, and visual hierarchy.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Created logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses.
Designed social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for startups and SMBs.
Collaborated with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff.
Used Photoshop and Illustrator for product visuals and marketing assets.

projects.name: Social Campaign for Fashion Brand
bullets: Executed an Instagram and Facebook series that achieved a 15% increase in follower engagement.

projects.name: AT Creation Startup Branding Kit
bullets: Delivered a complete branding kit including logo, typography, and colour palette.

education.institution: RGCERT Chandrapur (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University)

emphasis: Led with her current role at Ascent Business Solutions, emphasizing digital and print creative execution, brand asset management, template systems, and cross-functional stakeholder collaboration to match the Apricot graphic designer requirements.
